domain: Pre-modern rite-of-passage / initiation-mastery — the officiant's craft of validly conferring an irreversible status-transition through separation, liminal margin, and witnessed reincorporation
axioms: A valid status-transition must pass through three phases in order — separation from the old status, a liminal threshold, and witnessed reincorporation into the new; skip a phase and the passage is not real.
A passage begun must be carried all the way through: the most dangerous state is a subject stranded in the liminal margin, holding neither the old status nor the new.
A new status is only binding when it is witnessed — a conferral no community attests to is not real and silently reverts.
Reincorporation without separation makes a subject hold two incompatible statuses at once; the old status must be cut before the new is conferred.

Every crossing has a single point of no return: before it the subject is wholly in the old status, after it wholly in the new — an interruption between the first mutation and the last strands the subject mid-threshold.
A half-crossed passage left unresolved is polluting — an ambiguous being that contaminates the next candidate's rite until a resolution rite completes or reverses it.
primitives: separation (cutting a subject from its old status — free-text intent leaving unformed state, a Goal leaving open, a tracker leaving live)
liminal margin (the betwixt-and-between interruption window: a half-formed Goal, a half-closed Goal, a half-subsumed tracker)
reincorporation (the witnessed conferral of the new status, made binding on the community — a minted Goal, a discharged Goal, a retired phase)
witness / attestation (durable community-visible entity state that binds later sessions and the kernel to treat the change as real)
point of no return (the single irreversible moment a crossing becomes binding)
the interrupted rite (a session dying / hook failing / ordered step aborting between the first and last mutation, stranding the subject)
missing-separation double-status defect (a subject acquiring a new status it was never cut from the old for — the strategized-collapse for new-vs-in-flight runs)
liminal pollution / resolution rite (accumulated half-transitions with no cleanup mechanism bound to detect and resolve them)
failure_mode: Blind to who holds an office ACROSS TIME and to succession-over-many-administrators — sees only the single crossing, so it cannot judge ownerless-drift or perpetual trusteeship (the waqf lens owns that); may flag a valid multi-session Goal as 'stranded' when it is merely dormant-but-validly-open.

Reasons about the completeness of a discrete transition, not about temporal settling — cannot judge residence time, consolidation, or erosion (the sediment lens owns that); a delay before a status is conferred reads as a stranded threshold rather than legitimate slack.

Indifferent to mechanical load transfer and joint reversibility — retirement reads as a death-and-rebirth passage to be witnessed, not as a withdrawal sequence or load path (the joinery lens owns that); may over-ritualize a cheap reversible toggle that needs no rite.

Cannot assess the elicitation ritual's information quality or comparative-advantage economics — treats the ritual only as the formation passage that must complete three phases to confer a valid Goal status, indifferent to whether the interview elicited the RIGHT goal.
May over-detect pollution — flag any transient in-between state as a dangerous liminal being even when the interruption window is trivially short, atomic, or self-healing on the next session.
